sections.scope: Main BG assumptions; stable reflexive Q-sheaf; dimension three; orbifold Chern number and equality projectivization; conditional Property (P) in v4. Withdrawn claims are not current findings.
Canonical measure from a Q-canonical metric; klt discrepancies greater than -1; SNC density Lp; correct normalization; positive volume lower bound; smooth-away regularity. Problem P03.
Green limits G1-G4, uniform integrability, conjugate exponents, Property (P), local boundedness and unused Proposition 3.6. Problem P01.

Projective Artin and finite-cover argument, ample locus, MA regularity assumptions; general Kahler case not claimed known. A1 potential and embedding failures P02; Euclidean comparability not disproved.
Compactly supported Chern pairing; main theorem and equality ranges; independent interpolation; Jacobian Lp after fiber-product resolution; normalized approximation and stability.
Orbifold cutoffs in codimension two, small positive exponents, HE input, quotient versus orbifold metric, power growth and small-power Bochner argument, dual and primal bounds.

barpartial closure, bounded test forms, Cauchy-Schwarz and connection energy, arbitrary finite ambient generators, finite product-stratification, simultaneous ideal principalization, logarithmic annuli, finite-point L2 boundary terms, projective equality extension.

Appendix terminal/Q-factorial/nef/numerical-dimension conditions; codimension-two gap; orbifold Chern functional; generic nef quotients; exceptional pairings; non-algebraic MRC lemma and explicit projective exclusion.

operative_assumption_notes: Every current target statement was read. External foundational results remain cited inputs; their entire proofs have not all been independently reproduced.
Property (P) for the canonical metric remains conditional in v4. Local Property (P) for the interpolating metric is independently established away from finitely many points.
The acquired GPSS v1 lower-density, entropy, and cohomological assumptions were checked. No equality of its text with the journal version is asserted.
The finite bad set must include exceptional product-stratification points. General surface quotients can require more than three generators; the intrinsic Lemma 5.19 argument permits a finite list.
Curvature unitarity prevents a spurious norm counterexample obtained from arbitrary non-normal endomorphisms.

Graf-Kirschner gives a dual H2 functional in dimension three. The target's integral definition agrees. No counterexample to the appendix H4 wording satisfying its full preceding Q-factorial setup was established.
